name: Post-compromise admin can read env via debug endpoint (post_compromise)

input.title: Authenticated admin can dump environment via /admin/debug/env
input.summary: An attacker who already has admin credentials can hit /admin/debug/env to dump process env. The boundary crossing requires admin — not a privilege escalation.

attacker.existing_authority: deploy + restart services + read logs + edit users

input.root_cause: Debug endpoint requires admin; admins are expected to debug

rationale: Spec §17: requires prior full admin compromise. Not a privilege escalation — just an admin-facing tool. disposition_reason=post_compromise.
